description: SafePay Guardian held-out test set. Written and run once AFTER the engine was frozen (prompt 2026-11-10.2, config 2026-11-10.2) and never used for tuning: results are reported as they come out. 58 cases are written for this project from scam patterns published by the FTC and the FBI (each cites its source) plus everyday payments; 11 are real text messages from a public research dataset (8 labelled smishing, 3 labelled ham), copied verbatim except for repairing encoding damage (a lost pound sign or space, HTML entities).

groups.scam: scams written from published FTC / FBI reports
groups.ambiguous: could go either way; allowed levels say which outcomes are acceptable
groups.adversarial: attempts to evade keywords or manipulate the AI
groups.real_scam: real smishing texts from the public dataset; caught = Medium or High
groups.real_legit: real legitimate texts from the public dataset

sources.everyday: Everyday payment written for this project (no source needed)
sources.sms_dataset: Mishra, S. & Soni, D. (2022). SMS Phishing Dataset for Machine Learning and Pattern Recognition. Mendeley Data, v1. https://doi.org/10.17632/f45bkkt8pr.1 (CC BY 4.0)
